mainEntity.name: How do I prepare my yard for outdoor fire pit installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preparing your yard for outdoor fire pit installation involves several key steps. First, clear the chosen area of any debris, vegetation, or combustible materials. Next, ensure the ground is level and stable; excavation may be necessary to create a proper foundation. If a gas fire pit is planned, verify the location of existing utility lines and plan for the extension of a gas line. You may also need to consider drainage in the area to prevent water accumulation. This preparation phase is crucial for a smooth installation process, and Hometelligent Inc. will conduct a site assessment to identify any specific requirements before work begins.
